name: DividedLattice.exists_reducedInverse_eq
summary: Cut the pair (C, ϖ⁻¹G) to the places of M² (cutGL), giving c ∈ GL_n(𝔸_f); then γ = c̄⁻¹c is unitary, supported on M and M̄, and ϖγ⁻¹ ≡ G modulo M².

steps.claim: Let c ∈ GL_n(𝔸_f) be equal to C at the places of M² and to 1 elsewhere, with inverse ϖ⁻¹G there (cutGL with the idempotent of the places), once C·(ϖ⁻¹G) = 1 and (ϖ⁻¹G)·C = 1 are shown (?e).
steps.lean:
let c := cutGL (idem_mul_self O.chosenModulusSq.places)
    ⟨C.map (Ô E).subtype, O.genIdele⁻¹.1 • G.map (Ô E).subtype, ?e, mul_eq_one_comm.1 ?e⟩
case e => ext; simp [← Matrix.map_mul, h, apply_ite, -Subring.coe_subtype]

steps.claim: The idempotent of the places of M² times its conjugate is 0 (M² prime to its conjugate: idem_mul_star).
c̄ and c commute (they live at disjoint sets of places).
steps.lean:
have k : Commute (star c) c := Units.ext (by
    simp [c, cutGL, mul_add, add_mul, smul_smul, e, mul_comm]; ac_rfl)

steps.claim: Take γ = c̄⁻¹c: it is unitary (γᴴγ = 1 by step 4), supported on the chosen places and their conjugates (c is 1 off M², evalAt_star_GL), ϖγ⁻¹ is integral entrywise, and the reduction of ϖγ⁻¹ modulo M² equals that of G (reduction_congr at the places w of M²: there γ⁻¹ = c⁻¹·c̄ = ϖ⁻¹G·1).
steps.lean:
refine ⟨⟨⟨star c⁻¹ * c, Units.val_inj.2 (by simp [k.inv_right.eq] : star (_ * c) * 1 * _ = 1)⟩,
    by simp +contextual [Gf.atPlace, c, map_evalAt_cutGL, Units.ext_iff,
    evalAt_star_GL (star_star _), places_levelModulus_false], fun a b ↦ ?_⟩, Matrix.ext fun a b ↦
    reduction_congr _ fun w m ↦ ?_⟩ <;> simp (maxDischargeDepth := 5) [c, cutGL, mul_add, add_mul,
    e, mul_left_comm O.genIdele.1, ← mul_assoc (star _), mul_comm (star _),
    star_mem_Ô, O.genIntAdele.2, add_mem, mul_mem, sub_mem, ite_mem]

steps.claim: The remaining case distinctions on the places (split on the idempotent) hold by simp and grind.
